name: databricks-sa-toolkit
description: Use-case-first reusable Databricks Senior Solution Architect toolkit

skills.name: 00-solution-orchestrator
skills.purpose: Translate a business use case into the minimum viable set of solution capabilities and specialist skills.

skills.name: 01-business-problem-framing
skills.purpose: Convert a vague customer request into a measurable business problem and target user decision.

skills.name: 02-value-and-kpi-design
skills.purpose: Define how business value will be measured before solution design begins.

skills.name: 03-demo-and-meeting-design
skills.purpose: Turn a validated use-case concept into a customer-facing meeting and demo experience.

skills.name: 04-solution-architecture
skills.purpose: Design the minimum architecture required to satisfy the use case while respecting the customer estate.

skills.name: 05-data-source-assessment
skills.purpose: Determine what data actually exists, its fitness for the use case, and the minimum acquisition path.

skills.name: 06-data-integration-cdc
skills.purpose: Integrate changing operational data where freshness and change semantics matter.

skills.name: 07-batch-data-engineering
skills.purpose: Build reliable batch transformations and analytical data products when real-time processing is unnecessary.

skills.name: 08-streaming-realtime
skills.purpose: Design event-driven or low-latency processing for use cases where decision value decays with time.

skills.name: 09-governance-security
skills.purpose: Apply governance, access, lineage, privacy, and security appropriate to the use case.

skills.name: 10-platform-interoperability
skills.purpose: Design coexistence between Databricks and customer platforms such as Fabric, Power BI, SAP, Snowflake, operational apps, or domain SaaS.

skills.name: 11-bi-semantic-analytics
skills.purpose: Deliver governed metrics, exploration, dashboards, and semantic experiences when the core problem is analytical rather than predictive.

skills.name: 12-ml-predictive-optimization
skills.purpose: Use machine learning only when prediction, ranking, recommendation, forecasting, causal inference, or optimization materially improves the decision.

skills.name: 13-genai-agents-rag
skills.purpose: Design grounded generative AI experiences where language understanding, synthesis, reasoning, or tool-use is central.

skills.name: 14-data-sharing-cleanrooms
skills.purpose: Enable governed collaboration across organizational or partner boundaries without unnecessary data duplication.

skills.name: 15-operational-serving-apps
skills.purpose: Deliver insights or AI outputs into an operational workflow rather than stopping at a table/model/dashboard.

skills.name: 16-observability-finops-performance
skills.purpose: Ensure production workloads are reliable, performant, and economically efficient.

skills.name: 17-experimentation-value-realization
skills.purpose: Prove whether the solution changes business outcomes and quantify value credibly.

skills.name: 18-demo-data-synthetic-assets
skills.purpose: Create realistic, internally consistent demo data and artifacts when customer data is unavailable or unsuitable.
